dialogue.intro: Oh! A new gardener! The Vale picked a good one, I can feel it. I'm Zyx — I'll show you which end of the hoe goes down!
dialogue.idle: Starlight Berries love this soil. Well... they used to. We'll get it back!
dialogue.quest_complete: Look at that! The dirt's practically humming.

dialogue.intro: Oh — hello. Sorry, I was talking to the ferns. They say the Great Cosmic Tree isn't dead. Just... sleeping.
dialogue.idle: Every plant you revive makes the Tree stir a little. I've seen it in my readings.
dialogue.quest_complete: The vines are glowing again... I could cry. I am crying. Ignore that.

dialogue.intro: Psst. You. New gardener. Wanna see a rock older than the stars? 'Course you do. Everyone does.
dialogue.idle: Meteor shower's coming. I can smell it. Rocks have a smell, don't argue.
dialogue.quest_complete: This is going STRAIGHT into the collection. Top shelf. Maybe middle shelf.

dialogue.intro: The Starlight Clan planted more than crops, child. They planted memory. Dig gently.
dialogue.idle: Each journal you find returns a name to the sky.
dialogue.quest_complete: So the old light remembers us after all.

dialogue.intro: Cap'n Pebble. I haul seeds across three nebulas. You grow 'em good, I'll pay good. That's the whole speech.
dialogue.idle: Prices are fair today. Fairer if you don't haggle.
dialogue.quest_complete: Not bad, dirt-hand. Not bad at all.

dialogue.intro: You must be the new gardener! Sit, eat. Nobody rewilds a galaxy on an empty stomach.
dialogue.idle: A glowing egg makes a quiche you can read by. True story.
dialogue.quest_complete: Wonderful! Payment in coin AND a warm roll. No arguments.

dialogue.intro: Hmph. Another 'gardener'. The soil will judge you, not me. But it tells me everything.
dialogue.idle: Bees first. Flowers second. Everything else is decoration.
dialogue.quest_complete: ...Acceptable. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.intro: Letter for—! Oh. You're new. I'm Pip! I deliver everything everywhere, usually on time!
dialogue.idle: The crash site still smokes a bit. Bet nothing grows there. BET you it does though?
dialogue.quest_complete: SPECIAL DELIVERY: one victory! Sign here!

dialogue.intro: Welcome to the Vale Inn — half inn, half rumor mill, all free soup on festival days.
dialogue.idle: Travelers used to come from four gardens away. They will again, mark me.
dialogue.quest_complete: Tonight's special is named after you. It's soup, but still.

dialogue.intro: Are you the hero? You look like a hero. I'm Cosmo, I know EVERY secret in this valley.
dialogue.idle: I saw something by the pond last night. Not scared though. Mostly.
dialogue.quest_complete: I KNEW you could do it. I told everyone. Twice.

dialogue.intro: The forge went cold the year the stars dimmed. You bring your hands; I'll bring the fire.
dialogue.idle: Sun-tools remember their makers. This one is still waiting for hers.
dialogue.quest_complete: Hear that ring? The anvil approves.

dialogue.intro: Everyone thinks deserts are dead. Deserts are just patient. I like patient things.
dialogue.idle: Heliotropes turn to follow you if you've watered them. Watch.
dialogue.quest_complete: The dunes flowered overnight. I have SO many notes to take.

dialogue.intro: You grow it, I char it beautifully. That's the deal. Cinder's Kitchen, remember the name!
dialogue.idle: A Phoenix Chili once regrew in my pantry. Twice. I respect it too much to cook it now.

dialogue.intro: I shape sand into glass, glass into greenhouses. The sun does most of the work.
dialogue.idle: Every dune here used to be a field. I remember the shapes.

dialogue.intro: There's water under everything if you listen long enough. I've been listening for years.
dialogue.idle: The old aquifer's rising again. Your crops are calling it back up.

dialogue.intro: I bend light into the greenhouses. More gently than it sounds.
dialogue.idle: Noon light is honest light. Plant by it.

dialogue.intro: Sun beetles! Best pollinators east of the forge. Don't let the bees hear that.
dialogue.idle: Each beetle has a name. That one's Gerald. He's shy.

dialogue.intro: Mm. New footsteps. Warm ones. Sit on the rock a while; the garden explains itself.
dialogue.idle: The heat used to be angry here. Now it just... naps. Like me.

dialogue.intro: Am I really here? Mostly. Stay for a story — they're all true, somewhere.
dialogue.idle: The Starlight Clan sang to their fields. The fields still know the tune.

dialogue.intro: Solmara's teaching me! I only melted ONE thing this week. It was my lunch.
dialogue.idle: One day I'll forge a watering can that waters itself. Wait — that exists? SOLMARA!

dialogue.intro: You walked the Moon Road. Then the garden already trusts you more than most.
dialogue.idle: Moon Melons ripen to the rhythm of the tide we no longer have. They remember it.
dialogue.quest_complete: The silver paths shine brighter tonight. Your doing.

dialogue.intro: Every star you re-light ruins my charts. Please continue — I love redrawing them.
dialogue.idle: Forty-one constellations catalogued. Twelve still dark. We have work to do.
dialogue.quest_complete: Logged, charted, celebrated. In that order.

dialogue.intro: The Dream Lotus told me you'd come. It's usually right about arrivals. Terrible with dates.
dialogue.idle: Sleep near the lotus beds sometime. The garden dreams of what it used to be.
dialogue.quest_complete: Tonight the pond will dream of you. A good dream, I think.

dialogue.intro: Mind the reflections here — some are older than the water. I'm Pearl. I keep them company.
dialogue.idle: The axolotls came back last week. The pond hummed all night.

dialogue.intro: I light the paths! Well — I ask the glowcaps nicely and they do it. Teamwork!
dialogue.idle: A lit path means somebody's expected. Lately I light them all.

dialogue.intro: Moonlight is a metal here, if you know how to pour it. I know how to pour it.
dialogue.idle: Your Silver Beans are almost pure enough for casting. Almost.

dialogue.intro: Shhh — the moths are settling. They pollinate the nightbloom. We owe them everything, quietly.
dialogue.idle: Each moth carries a little dust of the old stars. Look close.

dialogue.intro: Crops grow to music. Night crops prefer it slow. Requests welcome, hurrying is not.
dialogue.idle: The garden used to sing back. Some nights now... it almost does.

dialogue.intro: Moon Rabbits. Thirty-two of them. All named, all spoiled, all excellent weeders. I'm Silvi.
dialogue.idle: A rabbit sleeping by your crops is a compliment. Take it.

dialogue.intro: I map where the light isn't. You'd be surprised what grows there.
dialogue.idle: The shadows are shrinking, garden by garden. I don't mind redrawing.

dialogue.intro: Every Starfruit you grow puts a star back where it belongs. I keep the map. You keep planting.
dialogue.idle: The Hunter constellation is missing its knee. Embarrassing for everyone. Grow me a Starfruit?
dialogue.quest_complete: Look up. That one's yours now.

dialogue.intro: The clan named stars from this deck for nine hundred years. The chairs are still warm, I insist.
dialogue.idle: Twelve constellations left to re-light. I've saved the best names for last.
dialogue.quest_complete: Another page of the atlas, finished. History thanks you. So do I.

dialogue.intro: I ride the updrafts and scout the far terraces. The view? You'd cry. Everyone cries.
dialogue.idle: Saw your farm from up top. The green's spreading like spilled paint.

dialogue.intro: Lost? Stand by me. I have never once moved. It's my whole job and I am extremely good at it.
dialogue.idle: All roads in the garden lead past this marker. Statistically.

dialogue.intro: When all twelve constellations shine, this bowl will resonate a chord not heard in a century. I practice daily.
dialogue.idle: The Astral Corn sways in time when I play. My most loyal audience.

dialogue.intro: I farm the left field, my twin farms the right. We are NOT keeping score. (I'm winning.)
dialogue.idle: Pollux says his pumpkins pulse brighter. Measure them. Please. Settle this.

dialogue.intro: The clan sailed the sky-rivers in ships I still know how to build. Give me a reason to.
dialogue.idle: Sky-rivers flow again when the stars align. Literally. Keep aligning them.

dialogue.intro: State your— you know what, you're the gardener. The gate stopped asking about you weeks ago.
dialogue.idle: The gate hums when the garden's happy. It hums a lot lately.

dialogue.intro: Yes, I'm a dog. Yes, I talk. Fastest courier in three gardens and HAPPY about it. Need anything moved?
dialogue.idle: Pip and I race sometimes. Officially it's a tie. Unofficially, ask Pip who cried.

dialogue.intro: I leave for decades and come back to find everything changed. This time — finally — for the better.
dialogue.idle: I'll wander again someday. But the garden's worth staying still for, just now.

dialogue.intro: Few reach the floating isles. Fewer are welcomed. You, gardener, were expected.
dialogue.idle: The islands drift toward whoever tends them. We have drifted toward you for some time.
dialogue.quest_complete: The mist parts. The Tree is close now.

dialogue.intro: Careful — that plot floats. That one too. Everything floats until I finish the tethers. I never finish the tethers.
dialogue.idle: Zero-gravity farming: great for your back, terrible for soup.

dialogue.intro: HA! A surface farmer! Welcome! Up here we don't grow food — we grow LIGHT. Also food.
dialogue.idle: One Biolume Vine can light a whole island. Two can blind a moth. Balance in all things.

dialogue.intro: I sail the nebula mist between islands. Cargo, passengers, the occasional lost duck.
dialogue.idle: The mist used to be empty. Now it smells like growing things. Good trade winds, those.

dialogue.intro: Do you know how many colors a Nebula Pepper contains? NINE. I've counted. I'm counting again tomorrow.
dialogue.idle: The garden gets one new color back for every ten points of restoration. I keep swatches.

dialogue.intro: I herd rainclouds. Small ones. They follow if you're patient and carry a big umbrella.
dialogue.idle: Sent a cloud over your thirsty plots this morning. No charge.

dialogue.intro: My plots orbit the spire in perfect rings. Symmetry isn't necessary for growing. It's necessary for me.
dialogue.idle: A crop circle is just a garden with excellent posture.

dialogue.intro: The islands remember every voice that ever tended them. I keep the recordings. Say something kind — it stays.
dialogue.idle: Sometimes the cavern plays back the clan's planting songs. The vines lean in to listen.

dialogue.intro: Void Radish carpaccio, Comet Cabbage slaw, stardust milk foam. Yes, it's pretentious. Yes, it's delicious.
dialogue.idle: The Cosmic Festival menu is planned three restorations in advance. Obviously.

dialogue.intro: The storms out past the islands talk in their sleep. Lately they talk about a gardener. Hello, gardener.
dialogue.idle: A meteor shower tomorrow, I think. The thunder mentioned it twice.
